en.title: Elimination Scoring Formats
en.excerpt: Understand the two World Archery elimination scoring formats: Set System Points for Recurve or Barebow and Cumulative Total Score for Compound divisions.
en.content:
World Archery defines two distinct scoring methodologies for head-to-head elimination matches depending on the equipment division: the Set System and the Cumulative Score System. In Archeris, the appropriate scoring engine is automatically configured based on division rules.

1. Overview of Scoring Systems

Unlike qualification where total accumulated score determines rank, elimination matches are evaluated end-by-end:

  • Set System (Olympic Format): Used for Recurve, Barebow, and Traditional divisions. Archers compete for Set Points in each end (2 points for winning an end, 1 for a tie, 0 for losing).
  • Cumulative System: Used for Compound divisions. Total arrow scores across all ends are summed together (e.g. out of 150 points for individuals).

2. Set System Points (Recurve / Barebow)

In individual matchplay using the Set System:

  • Each match consists of up to 5 sets.
  • In each set, both archers shoot 3 arrows (maximum 30 points per set).
  • Point Allocation per Set:
    • Winner of the set receives 2 Set Points.
    • If scores are tied in the set, each archer receives 1 Set Point.
    • Loser receives 0 Set Points.
  • Victory Condition: The first archer to reach 6 Set Points wins the match immediately.
  • If the score is tied at 5 - 5 after 5 sets, a one-arrow Shoot-Off is conducted.

3. Cumulative Total Score (Compound)

In individual Compound matchplay:

  • Each match consists of 5 ends of 3 arrows (15 arrows total).
  • There are no set points; instead, raw arrow scores (10, 9, 8, etc., with X counted as 10) are added continuously.
  • The maximum possible total score is 150 points (15 x 10).
  • Victory Condition: The archer with the highest total score after 5 ends wins the match.
  • If total scores are identical after 5 ends (e.g., 144 - 144), a one-arrow Shoot-Off determines the winner.

4. Team Matchplay Formats

Team elimination matches follow adjusted arrow counts and target point thresholds:

  • Recurve / Barebow Team (3 Archers): Up to 4 sets of 6 arrows (2 arrows per archer). Winning end = 2 pts, Tie = 1 pt. First team to 5 Set Points wins.
  • Recurve Mixed Team (2 Archers): Up to 4 sets of 4 arrows (2 arrows per archer). First team to 5 Set Points wins.
  • Compound Team (3 Archers): 4 ends of 6 arrows (24 arrows total, max 240 pts). Highest total score wins.
  • Compound Mixed Team (2 Archers): 4 ends of 4 arrows (16 arrows total, max 160 pts). Highest total score wins.

5. Format Comparison Summary

Division Match Format Individual Rules Victory Threshold
Recurve / Barebow Set System (2-1-0) Up to 5 sets x 3 arrows First to 6 Set Points
Compound Cumulative Score 5 ends x 3 arrows (15 total) Highest Cumulative Score (max 150)

id.title: Format Skor Eliminasi
id.excerpt: Pelajari dua format penilaian eliminasi standar World Archery: Sistem Poin Set untuk divisi Recurve atau Barebow dan Skor Kumulatif untuk divisi Compound.
id.content:
World Archery menetapkan dua sistem penilaian utama pada babak eliminasi sistem gugur satu lawan satu (*head-to-head matchplay*): Sistem Poin Set dan Sistem Skor Kumulatif. Sistem Archeris secara otomatis mengaktifkan format penilaian yang sesuai dengan divisi panahan yang dipertandingkan.

1. Gambaran Umum Format Skor

Berbeda dari babak kualifikasi di mana semua skor total dijumlahkan secara berurutan, babak eliminasi dinilai per rambahan (*end*):

  • Sistem Poin Set (Format Olimpiade): Digunakan untuk divisi Recurve, Barebow, dan Standar Bow/Tradisional. Pemanah memperebutkan Poin Set di tiap rambahan (2 poin bila menang rambahan, 1 bila seri, 0 bila kalah).
  • Sistem Skor Kumulatif: Digunakan untuk divisi Compound. Total skor dari seluruh anak panah dijumlahkan secara terus-menerus (maksimal 150 poin untuk individu).

2. Sistem Poin Set (Recurve / Barebow)

Pada pertandingan individu format Sistem Set:

  • Setiap pertandingan terdiri dari maksimal 5 set.
  • Pada setiap set, kedua pemanah menembakkan 3 anak panah (skor maksimal 30 per set).
  • Pembagian Poin Set:
    • Pemanah dengan total skor rambahan tertinggi memperoleh 2 Poin Set.
    • Bila skor rambahan sama (seri), masing-masing memperoleh 1 Poin Set.
    • Pemanah yang kalah memperoleh 0 Poin Set.
  • Kondisi Kemenangan: Pemanah yang pertama kali mengumpulkan 6 Poin Set dinyatakan sebagai pemenang pertandingan.
  • Jika kedudukan imbang 5 - 5 setelah 5 set, pemenang ditentukan melalui satu anak panah penentuan (Shoot-Off).

3. Sistem Skor Kumulatif (Compound)

Pada pertandingan individu divisi Compound:

  • Pertandingan terdiri dari 5 rambahan x 3 anak panah (total 15 anak panah).
  • Tidak ada perhitungan poin set; seluruh poin anak panah (10, 9, 8, dst., nilai X tetap dihitung 10) dijumlahkan secara kumulatif.
  • Skor maksimal sempurna adalah 150 poin (15 x 10).
  • Kondisi Kemenangan: Pemanah dengan akumulasi skor tertinggi setelah 5 rambahan memenangkan pertandingan.
  • Jika total skor sama persis setelah 5 rambahan (contoh: 144 - 144), dilakukan Shoot-Off 1 anak panah.

4. Format Pertandingan Beregu

Format eliminasi beregu menggunakan penyesuaian jumlah anak panah dan target kemenangan:

  • Beregu Recurve / Barebow (3 Pemanah): Maksimal 4 set x 6 anak panah (2 panah per orang). Menang = 2 poin, Seri = 1 poin. Tim pertama yang meraih 5 Poin Set keluar sebagai pemenang.
  • Beregu Campuran / Mixed Team Recurve (2 Pemanah): Maksimal 4 set x 4 anak panah (2 panah per orang). Tim pertama yang meraih 5 Poin Set menang.
  • Beregu Compound (3 Pemanah): 4 rambahan x 6 anak panah (24 panah total, maks 240 poin). Akumulasi skor tertinggi menang.
  • Beregu Campuran / Mixed Team Compound (2 Pemanah): 4 rambahan x 4 anak panah (16 panah total, maks 160 poin). Akumulasi skor tertinggi menang.

5. Tabel Ringkasan Perbandingan

Divisi Format Pertandingan Aturan Individu Syarat Kemenangan
Recurve / Barebow Sistem Poin Set (2-1-0) Hingga 5 set x 3 anak panah Pertama mencapai 6 Poin Set
Compound Skor Kumulatif 5 rambahan x 3 anak panah (total 15) Total Skor Tertinggi (maks 150)
